correctness.rationale: All constants are exactly left-zero elements, the monoid acts faithfully on them, so any abstract automorphism equals conjugation by their permutation. The unit translation group is the unique normal Sylow p-subgroup; normalization forces additive maps. The zero stabilizer gives scalar field automorphisms, recovering exactly the affine semilinear group. Conversely every candidate conjugates the entire monoid; the order and parameter recovery follow. Independent normalizer and multiplication-table checks match on listed finite instances, including F4 and characteristic two. Rank-zero boundary is proved separately.

value.rationale: This is a full natural symmetry classification for a noncommutative polynomial monoid occurring in modern algebraic monoid classifications, uniformly over all finite fields and dimensions. It proves abstract (not assumed regular or linear) rigidity and monoid-isomorphism parameter recovery, with explicit group orders and exceptional d=0 behavior. It is motivated independently of previously studied congruence invariants and is not a small arbitrary finite sample.
